CustomField.description: The comma separated keys of the Core features turned on (DataManager, DuplicateReview, OrgOptimizer, HouseholdUpkeep, Addresses, Relationships, Affiliations, PreferredEmail). Empty: all on (upgraded org). None: new install before first-run setup. NoneChosen: setup finished with none ticked. Keys stay: one-way (ADR-0124).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Core features turned on in first-run setup or in BarnCRM Settings, General, Features. A feature cannot be turned off once on.
CustomField.label: Features Turned On
